title: Sources: Spotify aims to launch an AI product in Q1 2027 that lets subscribers create their own remixes and covers for ~$5 per month, pending licensing deals (Anna Nicolaou/Financial Times)
summary: Anna Nicolaou / Financial Times: Sources: Spotify aims to launch an AI product in Q1 2027 that lets subscribers create their own remixes and covers for ~$5 per month, pending licensing deals — Streaming service plans to charge users up to $5 a month to use the feature — Spotify is targeting an early 2027 launch …
